name: Konstantinos Arvanitis - § 38 - Am 15
title: REPORT on the Commission’s 2025 Rule of Law report
part_text: 38. Is deeply concerned by corruption cases that have emerged within European institutions and stresses that the rule of law requires that persons holding public office cannot act arbitrarily or abuse their power for personal gain; calls on EU institutions to fully apply the principles of good governance, including transparency, accountability, and integrity; calls on the Commission to resume, within its Eurobarometer surveys, the publication of data on public perceptions of corruption not only at national, regional and local levels, but also within the EU institutions – the publication of which the Commission has discontinued, despite numerous serious scandals in the EU institutions;
